intro: The Boar Hunter is an early errand given by the dwarf hunter Talin Keeneye in Coldridge Valley. A surge in the local crag boar population has made the woods overly dangerous, and young recruits are tasked with culling the aggressive beasts so seasoned hunters can track in peace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.
Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I can go back to my... Leisurely... Hunting now. Thank you, friend.
